package.name: phm_ood_cpp
package.description: C++ (rclcpp) managed-lifecycle rolling-spread OOD node for the Policy Health Monitor. Subscribes phm_msgs/PolicyEmbedding on /policy/embedding, scores the rolling spread with the shared phm_core::OodCore (plain / Eigen / optional LibTorch kernels), applies the calibrated threshold with consecutive hysteresis, and publishes phm_msgs/DetectorVerdict on /phm/verdicts with source "phm_ood_cpp". Also provides the lifecycle node library that phm_ood runs, and the bench_latency micro-benchmark.
